A-10._reviewer_finding_content_hash_blind_spo: IMPORTANT REAL FINDING (round 1, carried forward): content/products.aspose.org/en/tex/python/_index.md's own `content_hash` frontmatter field is IDENTICAL before and after commit e42275e5d8 (e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924 both times), even though `git show e42275e5d8 -- content/products.aspose.org/en/tex/python/_index.md` proves the file's real content changed substantially (pip-install text removed, Font Management block rewritten, InputReader->InputSource). Root cause: compute_content_hash() in scripts/pipeline/lib/provenance.py hashed only the page BODY text after the closing frontmatter fence; this 'plugin' layout page type has NO body at all, so content_hash always equalled sha256('')[:32] regardless of what actually changed inside the frontmatter fields. For TC-tex-python-01's before/after pair above I substituted the real git blob SHA of the whole file (137713c839 -> 9ea28c03e6) instead of the page's own content_hash, specifically to avoid reporting a false pass.
